strings.en: What is that gigantic thing... A mobile armor?
With this Alpha Azieru, I won't lose!
Colonel.
Major Gato.
I will sortie as well, in the Neue Ziel.
I'm counting on you.
...Quess still has little combat experience... Back her up.
You who carry on the will of the late Lord Delaz... I have high hopes.
Sir.
Neue Ziel, launch!
The one that came out with that new model... Is that the Neue Ziel!?
Gato! Is that Anavel Gato...!?
...I have never felt better...
I fight for a great cause, alongside Zeon's last legacy...!
Gato...! You...!
Even I have not given up on realizing the ideals of Zeon...!
And now the time has come, Lieutenant Uraki.
I don't know who's right in this fight, or what great cause there is...!
But... we're settling this, Gato...!
The operation has failed... so why do they still need to fight!?
Damn it, Captain Quattro...! Why!
So there's no turning back, is that it!? Tch!
...Char Aznable... I said... I'd protect you...
Nanai! Eject her by force!
Nanai! Eject her by force!
...Ngh.
...Ngh.
Nngh... Argh!
Gato, I...!
...Heh. Without the rotten Federation, you would not suffer so...!
Why, Gato!? Ending it... like this!
I told you... did I not...
To pass on our true battle... to future generations...!
C-Colonel! I believe in your victory...
Nanai!?
Nanai, I'm going out.
Wait, Colonel! For you to go out yourself...
No... It seems I have no choice. ...Dangerous ones... are coming.
Huh? ...Understood.
Colonel, I won't stop you any longer... but after Londo Bell is defeated...
Yes, I'll do as you say, Nanai... Go to the combat bridge.
Yes...
Good girl. ...Sazabi, launching.
Bright red... A mobile suit as red as blood...!
So this is... it.
Yes... He's going this far.
Unless we talk with our fists, our hearts won't get through to him!
Hey, Quattro!
Sure, the Federation bigwigs do whatever they please!
I kinda get what you're saying!
But they're not all bad people, are they!?
If you drop a rock like that, it's over for everyone!
Can't we all work hard together... and change things!?
Char...!
Unlike you, I cannot afford to be just a pilot!
What that man is aiming for... is different from Iron Mask...
But... but the means to get there are the same...!
Cecily...
Captain! That's nothing but ego! The Earth...!
...Earth can't swallow all of humanity's ego...!
Human wisdom can overcome something like that!
Then grant those ignorant masses wisdom right now!
Yes... That's why Captain Quattro... But this isn't the way...
Kenrou!
Rom!?
Dangaioh, on the scene!
We're here too!
Sorry for the wait! I rounded everyone up!
It took a little longer than planned... but it seems we're in time.
Now it's our turn to repay the people of Earth...
Yes. It's just a shame our opponent is a familiar face...
Looks like the asteroid has split apart.
So the cast is complete...
Dangaioh... Tobikage!?
Even Rom and his crew!
Whoa! It's a total all-star lineup!
...I've heard the story. In this battle...
we'll fight alongside Londo Bell to protect the Earth...!
I understand, Rom Stol. But... what I must do has not changed.
Char...!
Captain Quattro! Why... why!? We...
I... can wait no longer.
Damn, he was this desperate... and we never noticed...!
Captaaain...
...We've got no choice...! Let's go, Dangaioh!
A man like you... being so small-minded...!
Remember to your heart's content the pain you felt when Lalah died!
...You're pathetic!
What!? Why can't you see that you're the one wasting that power of yours!
...Look who's talking!
Colonel! I'll assist you!
Nanai... What about Axis?
It's fine... Everything is going according to plan...
...I see... I'm sorry.
An all-out battle!?
But this looks like the last of them... We can do this!
...Captain Quattro! Hasn't this gone far enough!?
Is there any point in fighting any more!?
...I... am no longer Quattro.
To us... you're still Captain Quattro!
Mia...
...I'm gonna knock some sense into you, no matter what...!
The malice... is gone!?
...Isn't defeating me enough!? Amuro! This is no different from a massacre!
Wrong!
Then what are you, trying to massacre humanity!?
...With such power... you sweep aside my allies who fight for mankind
like obstacles... Do you truly believe you're right!?
Is there any meaning in defeating Nanai!?
...True... perhaps there was no need to sink that ship...
Amuro! Is this your justice!?
Char!?
...With all that power...
those who side with me and fight for humanity, as if removing obstacles...
Isn't defeating me enough!? Amuro! This is no different from a massacre!
...True... this isn't a battle meant for needless destruction...
At this rate... it's no wonder the Einst abandoned us...!
Amuro! Is this your justice!?
Char!?
...With all that power...
those who side with me and fight for humanity, as if removing obstacles...
Isn't defeating me enough!? Amuro! This is no different from a massacre!
...True... this isn't a battle meant for needless destruction...
At this rate... it's no wonder the Einst abandoned us...!
I win, Amuro!
I win, Amuro!
Heh... It's time...
Heh... It's time...
What!?
Can't we stop it!?
It can't... be stopped now... The operation has failed.
Are you saying... Char has won!?
My monitor's... dead!? What! ...Damn it, I'm ejecting!
An escape pod...!? You're not getting away, Char!
Caught!? But...!
You don't know a thing about reforming the world!
What!?
Revolutions are always started by intellectuals.
They chase dreamlike goals, so they only ever go to extremes!
Meaning there's no building it up step by step.
You can't change everything... all at once.
...But after the revolution, even the noble spirit of revolution
gets swallowed up by bureaucracy and the masses...
The intellectuals hate that, and withdraw from society and politics
to become hermits...! So then!
I'm not thinking about reforming the world...!
You are!
You are, and that's why you started this fight, isn't it!?
Mia...
...You overestimate me...!
Hey... just now, near the front of Axis...
I thought I saw a flash, like an explosion...
Just hurry up and blow to pieces already.
...Shinobu!? Doesn't something seem off?
This... isn't what we calculated?
Captain... The rear section of Axis is off its expected course...
Hey! What's going on?
Show... What's wrong?
Axis... is falling to Earth?
...I've got it... That flash that looked like an explosion
seems to have come from its thrusters firing.
What!? So what happened!?
...The rear section of Axis was braked,
and lost the thrust it needed to break free of gravity...
...Curses! Nngh... I must admit, that was well played...
Hey, it's not too late!
If we smash the back of Axis, it'll burn up in the atmosphere, right!?
Yes, if it breaks into small enough pieces, that's possible...
Hey, old man Hazuki! Why're you clamming up!?
Hurry up and tell us the rear's weak spot or whatever!
The time limit! Commander!
...We have been had. At this rate...
All units, fall back! We won't make it!
Huh!?
No way...!? Can't we still make it now!?
We've been tricked...!
Char... He counted on Axis's brief destruction from the start...
We should have realized... from the start! To be misled by the time limit!
Dammit!
...We're withdrawing.
Huh!? Captain!
All hands... withdraw...! This battle... is our loss...!
No way...!
Like hell we'll leave Dr. Saotome to die!
Damn it all...! Argh!
Char... you...!
Captain Amuro!? There's a retreat order!
Hey, you're not...!
